{{Quote|Gather round, for today we embark on a desperate journey to free this world, and perhaps many others, from the growing Imperial tyranny.|The Graaf|<ref name="The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Graaf Savraan''', also known as "The Graaf", was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] known as a noble relative of the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Salliche/Legends|Salliche]] during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and supposedly critical of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] rise to power and his actions during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In reality, he was an undercover agent of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Graaf's reputation as a disgruntled noble with significant resources made him an instrumental part of an ambush on Salliche at [[Docking Bay 723]], intended to lure dissenters into being captured and imprisoned by Imperial forces.<ref name="The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide" />
